messages:
lee: heads up — starting ~12:08 UTC eu-west-1 runtime p99 jump to ~1.2s, p95 ~450ms. started right after the 12:07 deploy. dashboard: https://console.redwood/prod/metrics?range=15m
deploy-bot: deploy completed by marta (rev: abc123) at 12:07 UTC — runtime/batching changes included
marta: looking. early clue: continuous-batching flag toggled in that release. could be a kvcache interaction. grabbing logs.
samir: can we check active batch sizes and kv cache hit rate? if kvcache regressed, cold KVs plus larger batches = higher tail.
lee: kv_hit_rate down from 98% -> 76% for top-10 models. log snippet: 
```
[12:09:43] warn: kvcache miss spike model=llama-13b ctx=2048 misses=3200
[12:09:44] info: batch.exec size=32 avg_latency=110ms token_latency=14ms
```
yvonne: if autoscaler can’t add GPUs fast, we should shift traffic and reduce batch size temporarily. samir, can you advise safe batch cap?
samir: recommend cap to 8 for now. change runtime flag and shift ~60% to us-east failover. runbook: 
```
# reduce batch size
PATCH /api/v1/runtime/config 
{"batch.max_size":8}
# shift traffic 60% to us-east
POST /internal/traffic-shift {"from":"eu-west-1","to":"us-east-1","pct":60}
```
lee: trying patch now. quick note — autoscaler error when trying to add more GPUs: 
```
autoscaler: failed to allocate instance i-0a...: quotaExceeded: Requested vGPU quota 8 > limit 4
```
yvonne: OK I'll open quota request, but that's not instant. proceed with traffic shift and batch change.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift initiated by yvonne — eu-west -> us-east 60% (task id ts-998)
infra-bot: note — routing change may increase cross-region egress cost; estimate +$0.6/hr for current load
lee: batch patch applied, confirming runtime now reporting max_batch=8. starting to see p99 drop in eu-west from 1.2s -> 680ms.
marta: kv cache still warming; misses improving slowly. recommend targeted kvcache flush on models with bad miss patterns to avoid full cold starts.
samir: flush command (targeted): 
```
POST http://runtime-eu/internal/kvcache/flush?model=llama-13b&shard=3
```
lee: ran targeted flush for top 3 offenders. p99 now ~420ms, p95 ~210ms. good improvement.
yvonne: deploy rollback queued for abc123, but note rollback will revert batching fix and may reintroduce other regressions — prefer to monitor for a bit and then revert if stable. thoughts?
samir: if perf stable with batch cap and kv warming, we should still roll back the batching change in a patch to avoid future regressions. create a revert CL and canary it to us-east first.
lee: creating revert CL now (revert: abc123 -> def456). initiating canary to us-east only.
deploy-bot: rollback scheduled def456 -> canary in us-east at 12:40 UTC
infra-bot: canary succesful (us-east), no increase in error rate. 
marta: after canary we can promote revert to eu-west during a low-traffic window. need PM signoff on rollback change.
lee: note on cost — shifting 60% to us-east and targeted flush caused small spike in GPU usage; infra cost delta ~+$1.2/hr for now. we'll absorb for incident window.
yvonne: I've filed INC-2026-042 with initial summary and assigned to infra/eng-runtime for postmortem.
samir: follow-up items: 1) add kvcache miss alarms 2) add deploy pre-check for batch flag compatibility with kvcache 3) improve autoscaler error visibility for quota issues
lee: p99 in eu-west back to 380ms, all background tasks normalizing. closing mitigation loop.
infra-bot: rollback def456 promoted to eu-west at 13:10 UTC, deploy succeeded.
marta: thanks all — we'll sync tomorrow in the runbook review. :thumbsup:
